description_en: Disassociates a permission from a resource share. You can disassociate a permission from a resource share only if the resource share does not contain resources of the type indicated by the permission
description_zh: 调用DisassociateResourceSharePermission为共享单元解除共享权限。当共享单元下权限对应的资源类型没有关联具体资源时，才允许从共享单元中删除权限
kebab_example: aliyun resourcesharing disassociate-resource-share-permission --resource-share-id rs-6GRmdD3X0000 --permission-name AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisassociateResourceSharePermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the permission. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.help_zh: 共享权限名称。在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html文档中查看
parameters.name: permission_name
